items.title: Billy Bauer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: Or maybe it was Jerry Jerome actually, I can’t really remember.

ctx.x: The Cliquot Club Eskimos. Yes, you know it’s a ginger ale, Cliquot Club. That was the advertiser. Harry Reser. Are you sure he said that?
I think he did. Or maybe it was Jerry Jerome actually, I can’t really remember.
Flip played with Morgan. There was a Morgan he played with, and he played with Frankie Newton. That was his big thing. He was in in at Kelly’s Stable, but he played clarinet at that time.
